text.title: Claude Tool Use Worked Examples
text.summary: Runnable code for every rule in 01-core-rules.xml. The agentic loop sends messages with tools, detects stop_reason, executes all tool calls, appends the full response.content as the assistant turn, and repeats until end_turn or max iterations. Forcing a specific tool call with tool_choice is the most reliable way to get typed JSON output from Claude, bypassing the need for prompt engineering + json.loads + retry.

example.title: Loop with max-turns guard and full-content append
example.code:
MAX_TURNS = 15 messages = [{"role": "user", "content": user_input}]
for _ in range(MAX_TURNS): response = client.messages.create( model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=4096, tools=tools, messages=messages ) messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.content})
if response.stop_reason != "tool_use": break
results = [ {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": b.id, "content": execute_tool(b.name, b.input)} for b in response.content if b.type == "tool_use" ] messages.append({"role": "user", "content": results})
final_text = response.content[0].text

Forcing a specific tool (short form)
example.code: # Force a specific tool for structured output extraction message = client.messages.create( model="claude-sonnet-4-20250514", max_tokens=1024, tools=[json_tool], tool_choice={"type": "tool", "name": "output_json"}, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Extract: John Doe, 30, john@example.com"}] ) tool_use = next(b for b in message.content if b.type == "tool_use") data = tool_use.input # typed dict matching the schema
